context_requirements: Expression of the IL5 receptor complex (IL5RA and CSF2RB) on the target cell
Presence of IL5-driven signalling or an IL5-dependent autocrine/paracrine loop
A cell lineage that responds to IL5 (e.g., eosinophils, basophils, some B cells); the nine tested lines are not known IL5-responsive
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent transcriptional changes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of IL5RA/CSF2RB-dependent gene signatures after treatment
Changes in eosinophil- or myeloid-associated landmark genes that are not seen with vehicle
